name: Jarvis
author: VGS
description: Talk to a voice assistant. Turn Jarvis on or off. Turning it off stops its session and prevents automatic starts.

settings.privateWindows: 1password, bitwarden, keepass, proton pass, enpass, pinentry, seahorse, private browsing, incognito

mode.label: Talk mode
mode.description: Hold: Jarvis takes what you said when you let go of the Talk key. Toggle: the conversation stays open until you press Talk again. Always: say Hey Jarvis, then your request; Talk listens at once. Always needs the local voice and keeps the microphone open on this computer.

microphone.label: Microphone
microphone.description: The microphone a cloud voice uses. The local voice hears the system default, as dictation does. Set feedback tones in Appearance → Sounds.

speaker.label: Speaker
speaker.description: Half duplex: Jarvis closes its microphone while speech plays. Talk interrupts speech.

voiceProvider.label: Voice provider
voiceProvider.description: Local keeps speech on this computer and answers fastest.
voiceProvider.info: Local is the default. Realtime sends your voice to OpenAI, and Gemini sends it to Google's Gemini Live; both answer more slowly. Auto uses Realtime when an OpenAI key is stored and Talk mode is not Always; otherwise it uses Local. Changing this ends the conversation.

voiceAccount.label: Voice key
voiceAccount.description: Your key for the cloud voice: an OpenAI key for Realtime, a Gemini key for Gemini. With one key, Jarvis picks it. Get an OpenAI key from OpenAI API keys, or a Gemini key from Google AI Studio.

voice.label: Voice
voice.description: Who Jarvis sounds like, from the voices of the selected voice provider. Preview under Voice on Details plays one sentence in it.

localTier.label: Local voice model
localTier.description: Auto is the model that runs best on this computer. Choosing another model downloads it now. This choice changes the voice Jarvis speaks with. Dictation uses voxtype's model: change it with Choose model in Voice.

clonedVoice.label: Cloned voice
clonedVoice.description: Jarvis speaks in a voice recorded on this computer: yours, or one you have permission to use. The recording and the model stay on this computer. The model is Chatterbox Turbo by Resemble AI, under the MIT licence. It needs the Large local voice model on an NVIDIA graphics card.

brain.label: Account
brain.description: The account Jarvis asks: an API key you added, or an app you are signed in to.

model.label: Model
model.description: The model that answers you, from the list that the app or API key you chose above offers.

effort.label: Effort
effort.description: How much the model thinks before it answers. More effort takes longer.

fallbacks.label: Backup models
fallbacks.description: Jarvis tries these models, in order, when the answering app refuses or stops. It sends only the last request, not the earlier conversation.

brain.label: Account
brain.description: The account Jarvis tries next: an API key or an app.

model.label: Model
model.description: Empty uses Jarvis's normal default for that app or key.

home.label: Home folder
home.description: One folder for what Jarvis knows: your instructions in AGENTS.md, skills, memory and state. Every AI model uses them.
home.info: Jarvis adds the files the folder lacks and changes none it finds, but for skills/base, which holds the Jarvis skill VGS provides. Changing the folder ends the conversation.

startAtBoot.label: Start Jarvis at boot
startAtBoot.description: When VGS starts after you sign in, a tmux session starts Jarvis in your selected home folder.
startAtBoot.info: Changing the home or account restarts Jarvis after the new selection is checked.

bootSession.label: Session at boot
bootSession.description: Applies at the next boot. A session already running is not replaced.
bootSession.info: Resume the last session: Resume your saved Jarvis conversation and check its unfinished work. If that conversation is unavailable, a new session continues the saved work. Start a new session: Start a fresh conversation and continue the work saved in your Jarvis home. This does not erase your work.

taskTerminal.label: Task terminal
taskTerminal.description: Where a coding task's terminal opens. Auto uses tmux when it is installed, which runs several tasks at once; the floating terminal shows one task at a time.

cloudVision.label: Screen to cloud
cloudVision.description: Whether a screenshot or its text goes to a brain or voice outside this computer. Allow sends it, Never withholds it, Ask withholds it unless granted for the conversation. When the brain and the voice both run on this computer, they always receive it. Changing it ends the conversation.

privateWindows.label: Private windows

presets.value: 1password, bitwarden, keepass, proton pass, enpass, pinentry, seahorse, private browsing, incognito
presets.label: Password managers and private browsing

privateWindows.description: Comma-separated words. A window whose class or title contains one is painted black before a screenshot leaves Jarvis. This is limited protection: a title cannot reliably identify private browsing.

feedback.label: Feedback sounds
feedback.description: A sound tells you when the AI is still working. With the local voice, the dictation tones you set in Voice tell you when to speak.

binds.info: Hold the keys and speak to Jarvis. In Hold talk mode, Jarvis takes what you said when you let go; in Toggle mode the conversation stays open. Pressing it while Jarvis speaks interrupts it.
Turns the Jarvis microphone off, or on again. Mute stays on after a restart, and Talk does nothing while it is on.
Ends what Jarvis is doing now: listening, thinking or speaking.
Confirms the Jarvis request shown on screen.
Opens the Jarvis console window for typed messages.

shell.label: Shell tools
shell.hint: Commands are offered only when kernel confinement and protected paths are ready. Install Bubblewrap adds it when it is missing.

daemon.label: Daemon
daemon.hint: The service starts no audio capture.

keys.label: Provider keys
keys.hint: This check never reads a key or unlocks the keyring.

keyStore.label: API keys
keyStore.hint: Add key stores a new provider key in your keyring.

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.hint: Signed in does not prove that the AI answers. A test request may cost money.

voicePreview.label: Voice preview
voicePreview.hint: Jarvis says one sentence in the chosen voice.

personality.label: Personality
personality.hint: How Jarvis talks: the text under the heading ## Personality in AGENTS.md of the home folder. Every AI model reads it.

voxtype.label: voxtype
voxtype.hint: The local voice hears your words through voxtype, the dictation program.

voiceKey.label: Cloud voice key
voiceKey.hint: A key lets Jarvis use a cloud voice: the provider hears you and speaks the reply. Get a Gemini key from Google AI Studio.

audio.label: Audio
audio.hint: Half duplex closes capture during speech. Echo cancellation is not supported.

browserDriver.label: Browser driver
browserDriver.hint: Jarvis drives its private browser with agent-browser.

browser.label: Browser
browser.hint: Input grants apply to one site. Jarvis can act as you on that site.

localRuntime.label: Local voice
localRuntime.hint: Setup downloads models and verifies the selected runtime without opening audio devices.

tasks.label: Coding tasks
tasks.hint: Coding tasks whose agent is starting or running.

input.label: Desktop input
input.hint: Protected layer rectangles include pass-through gaps. Unrecognized applications refuse input.

setup.label: Setup
setup.hint: Jarvis needs an AI model and the selected voice provider. The browser and input are optional.

setupHome.label: Home folder
setupHome.hint: Jarvis reads your instructions and skills from the home folder.

setupSignIn.label: Sign in
setupSignIn.hint: Use a Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Pi account, then select it in Settings > AI model.

setupModel.label: AI model
setupModel.hint: Jarvis uses the AI model to answer you.

setupVoice.label: Voice
setupVoice.hint: Jarvis uses the selected voice provider to hear you and speak.

setupBrowser.label: Browser
setupBrowser.hint: Set up the browser so Jarvis can use websites for you.

setupInput.label: Input
setupInput.hint: Check input so Jarvis can type and click for you.

setupFleet.label: Agent fleet
setupFleet.hint: Jarvis can hand a request for your agent fleet to your Jarvis session.

clonedVoiceSetup.label: Cloned voice
clonedVoiceSetup.hint: Lets Jarvis speak in a voice recorded on this computer. Set it up, then turn on Cloned voice in Settings under Local voice. Remove recording deletes the recording.

copilotMemory.label: Copilot Memory
copilotMemory.hint: Open GitHub Copilot settings and set Copilot Memory to Disabled. GitHub keeps this memory in your account, where only you can turn it off.
